title: A grade converter
description:
Turn a mark out of 100 into a letter grade with a `switch` expression.

```
Mark: 83
83 is a B
```
hints: `mark switch { >= 90 and <= 100 => "A", >= 80 and < 90 => "B", ..., _ => "" }`, with the out-of-range case caught before or by the `_` arm (lesson 1.05).
Return `null` from the `_` arm and test `if (grade is null)` to print the error.
requirements: 90 to 100 is A, 80 to 89 B, 70 to 79 C, 60 to 69 D, 0 to 59 F.
Any other number prints `Marks go from 0 to 100`.
Use a `switch` expression with relational patterns (`>= 90 and <= 100 => "A"`).
stretch: Add `+` and `-` (for example 87 to 89 is B+, 80 to 82 is B-).
